items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: I took a fellow named Mike... He played guitar in bands and sang... I went to take Mike's place after Chad Limited.

ctx.x: I took a fellow named Mike, he was a very versatile man like me. He played guitar in bands and sang, and he was older than me. He was down here when Louis Armstrong came to me on you somewhere in the 30 and played somewhere out there in the middle.
And you were playing banjo at this time?
